# `^FM` – Multiple Field Origin Locations

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/comparisons/README.md)


Designates multiple field origin locations for PDF417 and MicroPDF417 bar codes when using structured append capabilities.

Reference parameters: **x1, y1**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 197](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
